items.description: SC-E1: Audit flag E1. B0014 says the dual-branch reconstructor (Wang 2024) and the multi-branch network (Yu 2024a) 'all sit downstream of a reconstruction operator'; Yu 2024a's SA-HFL reconstructs conductivity from the measurement voltages and its aim is high-resolution reconstruction with robustness to measurement noise and modelling errors, not noise tolerance alone. Restrict 'downstream' to the branch tested here and the post-processing networks; describe Yu 2024a as the abstract does.

evidence_anchor.quote: All sit downstream of a reconstruction operator, as do the post-processing networks for EIT

items.suggested_action: Rewrite the two clauses; re-anchor Yu 2024a on its abstract.
items.verification_criteria: B0014 no longer places the Wang 2024 and Yu 2024a networks downstream of a reconstruction operator; Yu 2024a is described as reconstructing from voltages with branches fused for robustness to noise and modelling errors; the citation anchor quotes the abstract.
